name: velocity-fade-list
title: Velocity Fade List
description: List items whose opacity and vertical blur respond to scroll velocity — scrolling fast dissolves the rows into streaks, slowing down brings them back into focus — motion feedback that measures impatience.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Dense
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Kinetic
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Scroll Velocity Trigger: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
